Prof. Chao-Yuh Yang

Birth Year

1939

Birth Place

Taiwan/Pingtung

First year, first city and state arrived in the U.S.

1982, Houston, Texas

Address

Houston, TX

Family

1. Wife: 羅滿蘭

2. Son: 楊澤銘

3. Son: 楊澤笙

4. Son: 楊澤良

Education

1. 淡江大學

1962

B.S., Chemistry

2. 德國哥廷根喬治奧古斯特大學(Georg-August University)

1973

Ph.D., Organic chemistry

Employment

1. 西德國家科學研究院Max-Planck實驗醫學研究所

1973 - 1982

科學家

2. Baylor College of Medicine

1982 - 2009

Porfessor

2008 - Present

Scientific & Technical Director

4. Baylor College of Medicine, Dept of Medicine

2009 - Present

Professor Emeritus

5. 中國醫藥大學

2010 - Present

Visiting Professor

Accomplishment

1. 西德台灣同鄉會會長及全歐台灣同鄉會會長

2. 休士頓台灣同鄉會會長1986

3. 美國西南區台灣同鄉會區理事長 1987

4. 休士頓台灣人教授協會會長 1988

5. 休士頓台美公民協會會長 1989

6. 休士頓台美學會會長 1999 - 2003

Hobby

旅遊, 社區服務，長期關心台灣民主政治之發展，積極參與故鄉貧困學童認養工作，幫助南投921災區家境貧困的學童及屏東地區貧困學童

Notable Accomplishments

President of Taiwanese Association of West Germany and Taiwanese Association of Europe

President of Taiwanese Association of Houston (1986)

Regional Director of Taiwanese Association of America, Southwest Region (1987)

President of Taiwanese Professor Association of Houston (1988)

President of Taiwanese American Citizens League, Houston (1989)

President of Taiwanese American Association of Houston (1999-2003)

Long-term supporter of Taiwan democratic development; active in sponsoring disadvantaged children in Nantou 921 earthquake disaster area and Pingtung region
